facts.text: Legal residents of Alabama, Florida, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee are eligible for in-state tuition rates at the University of West Georgia by submitting a Border State Waiver.

sources.title: Go West. Go Affordably. | UWG
sources.quote: All legal residents of Alabama (effective Spring 2018), Florida, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee (effective Fall 2022) are eligible for in-state tuition rates by submitting this Border State Waiver (PDF).
